__comment: TST.2 / ARCH.1 Resolution 3 -- SMS HITL onInboundReceived injection contract.
Test seam: SmsHitlAdapterOptions.onInboundReceived is the sole injection point.
When supplied, the adapter MUST call it instead of opening the real /twilio/inbound
webhook window. The function receives the outbound SID and returns a mock inbound
payload synchronously or as a Promise.
Falsifiability: remove the opts.onInboundReceived branch in the adapter (fall through
to the real webhook path). The test will fail because pipWrapperFetch never resolves
(no real Twilio network) and will time out or return source_unavailable.
(a) The adapter is constructed with a mock onInboundReceived function.
(b) Fetch resolves successfully using the mock return value (not the webhook path).
(c) The returned FeedResult matches the mock payload: body, direction, SID, to.
The runner wires mock_twilio_outbound_sid as the SID passed to onInboundReceived.
The mock_twilio_inbound_body + mock_twilio_inbound_sid together form the synthetic
inbound payload that onInboundReceived returns, bypassing all real network I/O.
name: pip_wrapper: sms_hitl onInboundReceived injection bypasses real webhook path
notes: The adapter MUST NOT open any real HTTP connection in this mode.
FeedResult.raw_value must reflect the inbound reply (direction: in), not the outbound.

name: pip_wrapper: sms_hitl injection returns deterministic value_hash for known payload
description: Gate self-check on the FeedResult produced by the onInboundReceived injection path. Verifies value_hash integrity is maintained end-to-end when no real network is involved.
notes: value_hash matches sha256(JCS(JSON.parse(raw_value))) for this payload.
Gate action is proceed (inbound body is 'YES'; HITL approved).
The gate boundary check is independent of injection vs real path: it only sees FeedResult.

name: pip_wrapper: sms_hitl injection with tampered value_hash is caught at gate boundary
description: If the adapter corrupts or forges the value_hash on the injection path, the gate self-check must catch it and emit a denial receipt.
notes: Forged hash must be caught regardless of adapter construction path.
This vector is identical in structure to the weather gate boundary tamper test.
Falsifiability: skip the hash self-check in pipWrapperGateBoundaryCheck.
The gate would then return proceed for a forged receipt -- the test fails.
